comparison.objective: Install foam protectors onto two bare picture-frame corners.
comparison.physical_skill: Align compliant pockets with two frame edges and push them fully home without shifting the supported frame.
comparison.success_condition: Both protectors seated, square, level, squeezed onto the frame, released and still; frame and existing protectors remain undisturbed.
comparison.reason: This is compliant two-axis press-fit packaging. It does not test adjustable-mechanism locking or response-driven commissioning.
